title: GTA6 Fans Outraged Over $400 Collector's Set Without Game
description: GTA6 fans are furious over a $400 collector's set that lacks the actual game, comparing it unfavorably to Red Dead Redemption 2's version, according to IGN.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Fans Are Outraged by $400 Collector's Set

As the anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to reach fever pitch, anything related to the title is heavily scrutinized by the community. According to a recent report by IGN Games, GTA 6 fans are currently expressing deep frustration over a newly revealed collector's set priced at a staggering $400.

The core of the outrage stems from a major omission: the expensive bundle does not include the game itself.

## The Controversy Over Pricing and Content

For a collector's set commanding a $400 price tag, players naturally expect a comprehensive package that lets them dive straight into the experience. However, the discovery that the set ships without the game has left many fans feeling alienated. In the gaming community, bundling physical or digital goodies while excluding the actual software at such a high price point has sparked intense debates about consumer value.

## Comparisons to Red Dead Redemption 2

In the wake of this announcement, disappointed fans haven't just voiced complaints—they have actively compared this new offering to Rockstar Games' previous releases. Specifically, players are looking back at the collector's edition of Red Dead Redemption 2 as a benchmark of how premium physical bundles should be handled.

These comparisons to the studio's past collector's sets have only amplified the current backlash, as players feel the new offering falls short of the standards set by previous titles.

## Editor's Take

Charging $400 for a collector's set that leaves out the game is a risky move, and the resulting fan outrage highlighted by IGN Games proves that players are paying close attention. Rockstar Games and its publisher need to listen carefully to community feedback to ensure future merchandise aligns better with player expectations.
